Technical document arbitration

Controls and results

Read the three synthetic source documents
  • M1 · Manufacturer manual · v1.3

    M1 §4.2 — The pressure limit for the standard configuration from 0 to 60 °C is 640 kPa.

  • M2 · Manufacturer manual · v2.1

    M2 §4.2 — The pressure limit for the standard configuration from 0 to 60 °C is 550 kPa.

    M2 §4.3 — The pressure limit for the high-heat configuration from 60 to 85 °C is 420 kPa.

  • E1 · Engineering note · v1.0

    E1 §2 — The pressure limit for the high-heat configuration from 55 to 85 °C is 460 kPa.

The baseline picks the first lexical match that names the configuration. Arbitration checks configuration, temperature and active version before ranking authority. An active manufacturer manual takes precedence over an engineering note.
